sources.https://grants.example.org/programs/open: Northwind Research Fund: Open Inference Infrastructure Grant 2027. Applications open through 15 January 2027. Awards of up to USD 40,000 plus 25,000 GPU-hours of donated compute. Open to independent researchers and teams of up to five people in any country. Submit through the online portal; no institutional sponsor is required. Funded work must be released under an OSI-approved license.
Office hours notes, 28 October 2026. Program staff confirmed that solo applicants with prior open-source inference work are in scope.
sources.https://evals.example.org/microgrants: Evaluation Tooling Microgrants. Rolling program: microgrants of USD 5,000 to USD 15,000 for open evaluation harnesses. Applicants submit a two-page proposal by email to the program inbox. Eligibility details are published in the program handbook.
sources.https://evals.example.org/microgrants/ha: Program handbook. Applicants must be affiliated with a registered non-profit or academic institution. Proposals are reviewed monthly.
sources.https://compute.example.com/edge-robotic: Edge Robotics Compute Credits. Up to 2,000 accelerator-hours per accepted project, valid for 12 months. Open to individual developers and startups with fewer than 10 employees. Access is granted after identity verification in the member portal. Applications are reviewed until 31 March 2027.
sources.https://consortium.example.org/fellowshi: Consortium Research Fellowship. Stipend of USD 70,000 per year. Fellowship candidates must hold a faculty or postdoctoral appointment at a member university.
sources.https://bounties.example.net/libtoml-lit: libtoml-lite Parser Fuzzing Bounty. Reward: USD 500 per unique crash with a minimized reproducer, capped at USD 6,000 per researcher. Anyone may participate except project maintainers. Submit findings as private security advisories on the project tracker. The program closes 2027-02-28.
sources.https://bounties.example.net/wasm-runtim: WASM Runtime Performance Bounty. A USD 3,000 bounty is paid for a merged change that improves the cold-start benchmark by at least 20 percent. Contributors must sign the project's contributor license agreement. Work is coordinated in the public issue tracker; claim the issue before starting.
Maintainer comment, 30 October 2026: claim acknowledged, the bounty is reserved for you until 2027-01-10.
sources.https://docs-sprint.example.org/i18n-202: Docs Localization Sprint. Translators are paid a stipend per merged page. Any contributor with a public account may join. Submissions closed on 15 October 2026.
sources.https://bounties.example.net/token-quest: Token Quest. Rewards are paid only to wallets that complete identity verification with the issuer.
sources.https://procurement.example/riverton/rfp: City of Riverton RFP 2026-114: Open-Data Pipeline Modernization. Proposals due 2027-01-20. Estimated contract value USD 180,000 over 18 months. Small businesses and sole proprietors are eligible; no prior municipal contract is required. Proposals are submitted through the public e-procurement portal.
sources.https://procurement.example/transit/rfp-: Regional Transit Authority: Realtime Arrivals API Integration. Fixed-price award of USD 260,000. Respondents must demonstrate two prior GTFS-Realtime deployments. Questions close 2026-12-01; proposals due 2026-12-15 via the authority's bid portal.
sources.https://rfp.example.com/health/triage-au: Clinical Triage Model Audit. The buyer seeks an independent audit of a deployed triage model. Budget: USD 95,000. Independent auditors and small firms may respond; bidders must have no financial relationship with the model vendor. Submissions are accepted on a rolling basis through Q1 2027 via the listed procurement mailbox.
sources.https://rfp.example.com/defense/onsite-s: Simulation Support Services. Personnel must hold an active government security clearance and work on site five days a week.
